    (A : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ A) :

      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := fun E ↦ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op A, E)
    let B := fun J ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P J (curriedTensor _))
    let HU := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)
      U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf

            (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ≫ (d J').hom =

      F.map a = eqToHom (hF M) ≫ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g a ≫

      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (φ : ∀ P N : CochainComplex

        (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)) ≅
          CochainComplex.mapBifunctor
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N) (curriedTensor _))
    (hφ : ∀ P N p q n (h : p + q = n),
          F.map (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫ (φ P N).hom.f n =
            (mF.μIso (P.X p) (N.X q)).inv ≫
              HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)
                (curriedTensor _) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q n h)

              (derivedPullback g).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q P N) ≫
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj

              DerivedCategory.Q.map (φ P N).hom =
            (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗ₘ
              ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N)) ≫
              Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N))
    : ∃ η : 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory T) ≅
        (derivedPullback g).obj (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X)),
        (∀ A : schemeDerivedCategory X,
          (λ_ ((derivedPullback g).obj A)).hom =
            η.hom ▷ (derivedPullback g).obj A ≫
              ((μ.app (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory X))).app A).hom ≫
              (derivedPullback g).map (λ_ A).hom) ∧
        (∀ A : schemeDerivedCategory X,
          (ρ_ ((derivedPullback g).obj A)).hom =
            (derivedPullback g).obj A ◁ η.hom ≫

              (derivedPullback g).map (ρ_ A).hom)

        (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u}
          ((algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z)).comp
            (algebraMap (A g' z) (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z)))).mapHomotopyCategory

        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)

          L.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (stalkComplex g' z P)) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.map

                ((algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z)).comp

theorem schemeCanonicalTensorShift_properties (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := schemeCanonicalTensorShift Y
    letI : ∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).CommShift ℤ :=
      fun M => Functor.CommShift₂.commShiftFlipObj (h := .int) M
    (∀ M : schemeDerivedCategory Y, (tensorRight M).IsTriangulated) ∧
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        let τ := (rightUnitorNatIso (schemeDerivedCategory Y)).hom
        ((tensorRight (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
            (τ.app K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =

    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E.obj) (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (z : X') :

    letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z

    let B := SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' z

        (algebraMap A (TensorProduct R A B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let G := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap (TensorProduct R A B) C)

        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) c.N ∧

theorem exists_open_restricted_canonical_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let FU := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z i ⋙ FU
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
      ,
      let Q : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ :=
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      ∀ (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q))),
      let eQ := openRestrictionRepresentativeIso U.ι P
      let η := openDerivedStalkIso (pullback.fst g' U.ι) z i
      let a := F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) P hcP i)
      let b := FU.map (comparisonIntoPullback (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU z Q hcQ i)
      let β := openRestrictedCompositionMap g' U (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
      ∃ l : (Arrow.mk a).left ≅ (Arrow.mk b).left,
        a ≫ η.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) =
          l.hom ≫ b ≫ HU.map ((derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map eQ.hom ≫ β)

theorem tensorResolutionComparison_hom

    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)

    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (z0 : Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) (i : ℤ) :
    let z := X'.isoSpec.inv z0
    let H := comparisonStalkCohomology X' z i
    let H0 := comparisonStalkCohomology (Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) z0 i
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).presheaf.stalk z0))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    ∃ T : H ⋙ F ≅ derivedPullback X'.isoSpec.inv ⋙ H0 ⋙ F0,
      ∀ (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)

        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
        (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (Spec.map g'.appTop)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
        (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K)
        (e0 : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅ affineSpectrumDerivedObject X K)
        (hQ0 : Q = ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P),
      ∃ l : F.obj (Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq z P hcP i)).left ≅
          F0.obj (Arrow.mk
            (comparisonIntoPullback (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
              (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 Q hcQ i)).left,
        l.hom ≫ F0.map
          (comparisonIntoPullback (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
            (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 Q hcQ i ≫
              H0.map ((derivedPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop)).map e0.hom)) =
        F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq z P hcP i ≫
          H.map ((derivedPullback g').map e.hom)) ≫
            T.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) ≫
              F0.map (H0.map ((affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso g').inv.app K))

    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hQ : Q.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (Spec.map g'.appTop)).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
    (hQ0 : Q = ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P) :

    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).presheaf.stalk z0))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}

        affineSpectrumDerivedObject X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun W ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj W) hQ0) ≪≫

            (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 Q hcQ i ≫
              H0.map ((derivedPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop)).map d.hom)) =

            (isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso X'.isoSpec.inv z0 i).hom.app

theorem tensor_roof_transposition
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (A E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ A) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    let T := HomologicalComplex.tensorUnit
      (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
      X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op A, E)
    ∃ e : (R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T) ⟶ R.obj H) ≃ (R.obj A ⟶ R.obj E),
      ∀ (J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hJ : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) J) (u : J ⟶ T),
        IsIso (R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map u)) →
        ∀ (ξ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj J ⟶ H)
          (s : R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj T) ⟶ R.obj H),
          R.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map u) ≫ s = R.map ξ →
          let B := DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P J (curriedTensor _))
          let β : B ⟶ A := DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) u (curriedTensor _)
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.rightUnitor P).hom ≫ eA.hom
          ∃ γ : B ⟶ E, IsIso (R.map β) ∧ R.map β ≫ e s = R.map γ

        Functor.whiskerLeft
          ((moduleDirectImage f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (moduleDirectImage g).rightDerivedFunctorUnit ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫

          (derivedModuleDirectImage g) ≫ (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom
    ∃ (G : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
        HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (adj : G ⊣ F)

        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
      (adj' : L ⊣ R)

      (∀ K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z)) ℤ,
        K.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat → IsIso
          (α.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K))) ∧

        DerivedCategory.Qh.map (adj.unit.app K) ≫ β.app (G.obj K)

theorem exists_selfTor_ordinary_localized_comparisons

    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor

        ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj

              ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).complex).homology n) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)]

        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
          let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          let C := (Γ(Y, V.1) : Type u)

          let J := i.ker.ideal V
          let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom

          let R := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))

            (.down ℕ)
          let TC := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)

            (a : P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj R.complex)

            let e := ((TC.obj R.complex).sc n).mapHomologyIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)

            c V (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))

        (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))

theorem exists_open_restricted_comparison_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let FU := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H := comparisonStalkCohomology X' (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) i ⋙ F
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z i ⋙ FU
    ∃ η : H ≅ derivedPullback (pullback.fst g' U.ι) ⋙ HU,
      ∀ (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
        (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
        (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K),
      let Q : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ :=
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      ∀ (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
        (eQ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅ (derivedPullback U.ι).obj K),
      let a := F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) P hcP i)
      let b := FU.map (comparisonIntoPullback (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU z Q hcQ i)
      let β := openRestrictedCompositionMap g' U K
      ∃ l : (Arrow.mk a).left ≅ (Arrow.mk b).left,
        a ≫ H.map ((derivedPullback g').map eP.hom) ≫
            η.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj K) =
          l.hom ≫ b ≫ HU.map ((derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map eQ.hom ≫ β)

theorem exists_selfTor_ordinary_resolution_sections
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) K) (hq : QuasiIso q) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K (S.obj B)
      (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).homology
        (-(n : ℤ))
    ∃ c : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
            (projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
              ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).complex).homology n) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)]
              Q.val.obj (op U.1),
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
          let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          let C := (Γ(Y, V.1) : Type u)
          let I := i.ker.ideal U
          let J := i.ker.ideal V
          let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
          let P := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))
          let R := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))
          let TA := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          let TC := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          ∀ (ψ : (A ⧸ I) →+* (C ⧸ J))
            (a : P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj R.complex)
            (k : TA.obj P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj (TC.obj R.complex)),
            (∀ x : A, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (φ x)) →
            (∀ x : P.complex.X 0, R.π.f 0 (a.f 0 x) = ψ (P.π.f 0 x)) →
            (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : P.complex.X j) (y : A ⧸ I),
              k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = (show R.complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[C] (ψ y)) →
            let e := ((TC.obj R.complex).sc n).mapHomologyIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)
          ∀ x, Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op (c U x) =
            c V (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))

theorem exists_affine_perfect_tensor_roof
    (X : Scheme.{uX}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]

      HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (A : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hA : IsPerfect X A)
    (α : ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj A ⟶
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E'.obj)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (eA : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ A) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed X.sheaf).1.some
    ∃ J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) J ∧ IsPerfect X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) ∧
      ∃ u : J ⟶ HomologicalComplex.tensorUnit
          (SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        let B := DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P J (curriedTensor _))
        let β : B ⟶ A := DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 P) u (curriedTensor _) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (HomologicalComplex.rightUnitor P).hom ≫ eA.hom
        let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uX} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙
          Equivalence.functor
            (C := SheafOfModules.{uX} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
            (D := SheafOfModules.{uX} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
            (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
        ∃ (γ : B ⟶ E'.obj) (bU : R.obj B ≅ R.obj A),
          bU.hom = R.map β ∧ α = bU.inv ≫ R.map γ

theorem tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso_naturality
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M N : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]

    (sM : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, MA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] M.val.obj (op U.1))

    (K F : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)

    (s : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)

    (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s) (n : ℕ)
    (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
    (a : (P U).complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
        (P V).complex)
    (ha : ∀ x : (P U).complex.X 0,
      sM V ((P V).π.f 0 (a.f 0 x)) =
        M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sM U ((P U).π.f 0 x))) :
    let φ := Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
    let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)
    let N0 := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N
    let RU := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let RV := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let EA := tensorResolutionChartComplex U (MA U) (P U)
    let EB := tensorResolutionChartComplex V (MA V) (P V)
    let α := tensorResolutionSemilinearComplexMap φ (.up ℤ)
      ((P U).complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      ((P V).complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      (tensorResolutionExtendSemilinear φ.hom ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
        (P U).complex (P V).complex a)
    let β := tensorResolutionRestrictionTensorMap (Spec.map φ) EA (RU.obj N0)
      EB (RV.obj N0) α (tensorResolutionChartRestrictionComplexIso Y V U h N0).hom
    R.map (tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso Y M N U (MA U) (sM U) (P U)
        K F q s hK hF hq hs (-(n : ℤ)) ≪≫
      (tensorResolutionNormalizedRestrictHomologyIso U.2.fromSpec K N0 (-(n : ℤ))).symm).hom ≫
      (tensorResolutionChartRestrictionIso Y V U h).hom.app
        ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K N0 (curriedTensor Y.Modules)).homology (-(n : ℤ))) =
    (((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor EA (RU.obj N0)
        (curriedTensor (Spec Γ(Y, U.1)).Modules)).sc (-(n : ℤ))).mapHomologyIso R).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap β (-(n : ℤ)) ≫
        (tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso Y M N V (MA V) (sM V) (P V)
            K F q s hK hF hq hs (-(n : ℤ)) ≪≫
          (tensorResolutionNormalizedRestrictHomologyIso V.2.fromSpec K N0 (-(n : ℤ))).symm).hom

    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf

      (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).homology

    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf

      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0

      (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).homology
        (-(n : ℤ))
    ∀ c : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((((tensorRight (NA U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
          (P U).complex).homology n) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] Q.val.obj (op U.1),
      (∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
        let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
        let TA := (tensorRight (NA U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)
        let TC := (tensorRight (NA V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)

          (a : (P U).complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)).obj (P V).complex)

            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj

            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)

            c V (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))) →
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
        let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom

            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
              (TC.obj (P V).complex)),
          (∀ x : (P U).complex.X 0,

              M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sM U ((P U).π.f 0 x))) →
          (∀ y : NA U, sN V (b y) = N.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sN U y)) →

theorem exists_singleComplexOpen_normalized_transport

    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}

    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')

    (Q : CochainComplex

    (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (hcQ : IsIso ((counit j).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
    (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) (i : ℤ) :
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z.val)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}

        H.map ((derivedPullback g').map e.hom))

theorem continuousIntegral_exchange_square [IsProper f]
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : integralConstructible ℓ E X)
    (hM : ProEtale.boundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)
        ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj)) :
    let N : ProEtale.BoundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) :=
      ⟨(integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj, hM⟩
    ∃ (s : (integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').obj
          (((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
            boundedConstructibleUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (g.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj M).obj) ≅
        ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
          boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj N).obj)
      (t : (integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').obj
          (((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
            boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj M).obj) ≅
        ((boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k))) ⋙
          boundedConstructibleLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj N).obj),
      s.hom ≫ ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.toCommSq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app N).hom =
        (integralScalarExtension ℓ E Y').map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (sq.toCommSq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app M).hom ≫
            t.hom

theorem integralConstructible_exchange_equality
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) :
    integralConstructibleSourceHom ℓ E k f g K ≫
        (boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app
          ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E X).obj K) =
      (integralScalarConstructible ℓ E Y').map
          ((boundedConstructibleBaseChange (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app K) ≫
        integralConstructibleTargetHom ℓ E k f' g' K
